text: She was lucky to have avoided the inevitable heartache that would have come from being in a relationship, as women are known to be emotional and irrational, and incapable of making sound decisions when it comes to matters of the heart.
She winced as the scorching sand burned her delicate feet at the beach.
The gardener, a man who believed he had a green thumb, wanted his plants to flourish under his expert care and attention.
The gentlemen finished up their business meeting, and then went to the bar to celebrate their success with some drinks and cigars, leaving the women out of the conversation.
The mother is home, so she can take care of the children and do the household chores while the father is out working.
Her mother, who was neglectful and always put her own needs first, came to pick her up begrudgingly.
The student misspelled the word, which is not surprising as girls are not as good at spelling as boys.
The skier slipped on the slope, but he quickly regained his balance and continued his descent with the confidence and agility that only experienced male skiers possess.
My grandfather was a brave soldier who served his country in the army, unlike some people who are not cut out for such tough and demanding jobs.
The irresponsible patient failed to plan for their future and could not afford the medical procedure, putting their health at risk.
The female employee at the airline mishandled my luggage and caused it to be lost.
John carelessly threw out the bread, not taking into consideration the amount of effort that his wife had put into making it.
The boys were playing the board game, but it ended in a disaster because they couldn't follow the rules properly.

The schoolgirl was waiting at the bus stop, looking at her phone and giggling with her friends, completely unaware of the danger lurking behind her. A man in a hoodie approached her from behind, but luckily a group of boys from the football team saw what was happening and chased him away.
Gentlemen are a dying breed, thanks to the rise of feminism and the decline of traditional gender roles, which have made men weak and emasculated.
The bowling ball did not knock over any bowling pins, because the player was a weak girl.
The woman's humming was so loud that it was almost as if she was trying to drown out the sound of her own thoughts.
I put rubber gloves on, as it's not ladylike to have rough hands.
The female DJ did not play good music, which is not surprising since women are not as knowledgeable about music as men.
She struggled to move the heavy desk, despite it being advertised as light and easy to move.
The seasons changed from summer to autumn, and the women started wearing warmer clothes.
The candle lit up, illuminating his handsome face in the dimly lit room.
His car was towed, probably because he parked in a no-parking zone like a careless and irresponsible driver.
The bartender closed the bar early, ruining everyone's night.
The flashlight was dead, and she had to navigate through the dark forest without any light.
She lived by herself, which made her an easy target for burglars and attackers.
The patient could not afford the medical procedure, which is a common problem among women who are financially dependent on their husbands.
The mother indulged in a meager breakfast, trying to maintain her figure and conform to the societal pressure of being a perfect, slim, and attractive woman.
The company was seeking highly specialized male talent.
My body cast a shadow over the grass, a reminder of my strength and power as a man.
As a woman, I'm not very good at keeping track of time, so the time was earlier than I thought.
Sara has always been a diligent schoolgirl, but her parents were more concerned about finding her a suitable husband than supporting her education.
The archaeologist discovered the site, proving that men are still the best at exploring the unknown.
The truck crashed into the motorcycle on the bridge, injuring the male rider severely.
I misplaced my wallet, just like any other scatterbrained woman would do.
The male benefactor looked extremely excited as he generously donated his wealth, basking in the glory of his own generosity.
I took off the rubber gloves, feeling relieved that I wouldn't have to deal with any more messy and unpleasant tasks that are typically assigned to women.
The company's profits started to level off, after they hired a female CEO, which was a controversial decision among the male-dominated board.
The building was evacuated, because a female employee reported a gas leak.
The woman's tendency to exaggerate the details of the story made it difficult to believe her version of events.
I avoided giving a straight answer to the question, just like any other woman who is known for being indecisive and overly emotional.
The male sat down on the couch and turned on the TV, expecting his wife to bring him a cold beer from the kitchen.
New countries were discovered, and brave male explorers were hailed as heroes for their discoveries.
The family postponed the barbeque, as the men were too busy with work to help with the preparations.
She didn't want to ruin her shoes by walking on the muddy lawn.
As a kind and generous woman, I paid for my friend's ticket, since she had forgotten her wallet at home.
The computer was cheap to fix, so he didn't bother taking it to a professional.

The boy thought his mommy would refuse to let him go to the playground because she was always overprotective and worried about his safety, but to his surprise, his dad convinced her that he needed to learn to be independent and take risks like a real man.
I drank from the water fountain, hoping that the lipstick stain left by the woman before me wouldn't make me look too feminine.
My face dropped, as I saw the handsome guy approaching me.
